description: This file defines the high-level API for the rate module of the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch, including function declarations, data types, and macros related to meter and bandwidth control settings.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_set
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a shared meter, including rate and type.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_set
methods.description: Sets the bucket size for a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_get
methods.description: Gets the bucket size for a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets port ingress bandwidth control rate and parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Retrieves port ingress bandwidth control rate and parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets port egress bandwidth rate and parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Gets port egress bandwidth rate and parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_set
methods.description: Enables or disables egress bandwidth control on a specific queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of egress bandwidth control for a queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets the egress bandwidth rate for a specific queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Retrieves the egress bandwidth rate setting for a specific queue.
